selected_sources.text: The final results that make it to an article, be it plots or tables, often represent highly summarized data.

When the storage context allows, it is better to simply incorporate permanent output of all underlying data when a main result is generated, using a systematic naming convention to allow the full data underlying a given summarized value to be easily found.
